videos.title: Acute Ischemic Stroke: Etiology, Pathophysiology, Clinical Features, Diagnostics, Treatment
videos.description: A comprehensive lecture on acute ischemic stroke covering embolic, thrombotic, and global hypo-perfusion causes, stroke syndromes and clinical features, diagnostic approach (CT, MRI, CTA, labs), and acute management including tPA eligibility and contraindications.

videos.title: Subarachnoid Hemorrhage | Etiology, Pathophysiology, Clinical Features, Treatment, Complications
videos.description: A detailed and systematic approach to subarachnoid hemorrhage covering etiology (saccular aneurysms, AVMs), pathophysiology of bleeding in the subarachnoid space, clinical presentation (thunderclap headache, meningismus), diagnostic approach (non-contrast CT, CTA, LP), acute management (blood pressure control, nimodipine, aneurysm securing), and complications (vasospasm, rebleeding, hydrocephalus).
